subject: Updated procedure: vendor bank change form VM-7 rev 4
text:
AP team,

VM-7 has been revised (rev 4, attached). Changes:

- New field for the callback phone number source (must be vendor master or a prior invoice, never the request itself)
- Second approver must now be outside AP
- A 3-business-day hold applies between approval and the first payment to a new account
- Changes submitted through SupplierHub still require the form

Use rev 4 for all requests received from Monday.

Treasury
label: ordinary
note: Internal procedure change about bank-change handling.
